dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: I can go scout ahead if you want.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: You've seen me at full speed. When I go all out, no monster can catch me.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe we should go together just to be safe. Alright — lead the way.
